g.text: PatientHospitalLink is omitted from this UI-facing view:
identity matching is API-backed, with no direct UI flow evidenced.
Clinical history is shown in the UI; some views may derive
an encounter from appointment data when no persisted encounter exists.
Backend record used by a current UI workflow; not independently managed
Related model shown in another domain diagram; only its identifier is shown
Scope: models are included only when a current UI flow uses them or they support that flow.
Attributes are schema fields; a UI may expose only a subset of them.
